records.problem_signature: Slow query whose plan shows repeated scan over a filtered column set.
observed_evidence: Read-only query plan indicates scan cost and filter shape.
records.solution_pattern: Propose an index only with rollback migration or backup evidence.
applicability_limits: Write action requires owner consent and maintenance context
records.rollback_or_reversal: Drop-index rollback migration or restore-ready backup reference.
records.verification_method: Re-run query plan inspection and compare index use and cost.
